cpp.source: int probe(int a) { auto first = a + 1; auto second = first * 2; second = second + a; return second; }
bool probe(bool a) { const auto first = !a; return first; }
unsigned int probe(unsigned int a) { auto first = a + 1u; return first; }
int probe(int a) { auto first = a, second = true; return first; }
int probe(int a) { int first; first = a; return first; }

rust.source: fn probe(a: i8) -> i8 { let first = a + 1; let mut second = first * 2; second = second + a; second }
rust.assertions: let _: i8 = first; let _: i8 = second;

rust.source: fn probe(a: bool) -> bool { let first = !a; let first = first && a; first }
fn probe(a: i32) -> i32 { let first = 4i32; let second = first + a; second }
rust.assertions: let _: i32 = first; let _: i32 = second;

rust.source: fn probe(a: i8) -> i8 { let first = 1; let second: i8 = first + a; second }
fn probe(a: i64) -> i64 { let first = 1; let second: i64 = first + a; second }
fn probe(a: i32) -> i32 { let first: i32; first = a; first }

func probe(a: int) -> int:
    var first := a + 1
    var second := first * 2
    second = second + a
    return second

    var first: int
    first = a
    return first
